description: Lists devices affected by one issue group with date, device, OS, version, sorting, and pagination filters.

app_id.description: Public app ID returned by list_apps.

date_range_end.description: Inclusive end as an ISO 8601 datetime.

date_range_start.description: Inclusive start as an ISO 8601 datetime.

device_udid.description: Filter by device UDID returned by search_devices.

hash.description: Issue group hash returned by list_issues or get_issue.

order.description: Sort expression supported by the Bugfender API.

page_size.description: Number of devices per page, capped by the server maximum.

name: get_issue_devices

data.description: Tool-specific result data, present when ok is true.

error.description: Error details, present when ok is false.

hint.description: Optional recovery guidance that does not expose credentials.

ok.description: True on success and false on failure.

pagination.description: Pagination state for retrieving more results.

title: List Devices Affected by an Issue
